component.name: Patrone Task Manager
component.summary: See what's running and how hard the computer is working

description.p: Patrone Task Manager shows the apps and processes running and what each uses, and works the way people who have used Windows expect.

ul.li: Processes, with processor, memory, disk and network use, and End task
Performance graphs for the processors, memory, disks, network and graphics
Each app's processor time since the computer started
Startup applications, with a switch to turn each off
Who is signed in, every process in detail, and the system's services

description.p: Patrone Task Manager as a Flatpak, for any Linux, seeing the computer's processes through a small helper.
